verdict.rationale: The evidence documents UI-based grant issuance, board consent generation, and pre-approved Equity Blocks, but nothing shows a programmatic surface (API, SDK, or MCP) through which an agent could draft securities and queue them for board approval. OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the llms.txt file only indexes help-center documentation. UI workflows and documentation readability are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
